svg.text: Finite comparison errors vanish without a limit map
Conditional input: actual generation + finite trace-preserving pair maps.
The finite maps are still unproved in general. No arrows identify different m.
1. A finite pair and its cup — r = 0, m ≥ i + 1 [65.4, 65.7, 65.9]
F = M₋ₘ′ ∩ M₋ᵢ₊₁
contains gᵢ ∈ M₋ᵢ₋₁′
U = Mᵢ₋₁′ ∩ Mₘ
contains eᵢ ∈ Mᵢ₊₁
αₘ,ᵢ
G = M₋ₘ′ ∩ M₋ᵢ
G ⊂ F
V = Mᵢ′ ∩ Mₘ
V ⊂ U
αₘ,ᵢ
K = G′ ∩ F maps onto H = V′ ∩ U; traces are inherited.
Lower cup: E_(M₋ᵢ′ ∩ M₋ᵢ₊₁)(gᵢ) = λ1. Cup image error ≤ εₘ,ᵢ.
2. The entire limit argument is an error bound [65.5, 65.8, 65.10]
Rₖ,ᵢ = Gₖ,ᵢ′ ∩ M₋ᵢ₊₁ decreases to M₋ᵢ′ ∩ M₋ᵢ₊₁.
δₖ,ᵢ = ‖E_Rₖ,ᵢ(gᵢ) − λ1‖₂ → 0.
‖E_Cᵢ(eᵢ) − λ1‖₂ ≤ ‖E_H(eᵢ) − λ1‖₂ ≤ δₖ,ᵢ + εₘ,ᵢ
Cᵢ = (Mᵢ′ ∩ 𝒯)′ ∩ 𝒯; i + 1 ≤ k ≤ m
Fix k, send admitted m → ∞, then k → ∞: E_Cᵢ(eᵢ) = λ1.
Kₘ,ᵢ need not be nested; αₘ,ᵢ need not agree on intersections.
3. Actual two-step endpoints — i = 1, m = 3 [65.12–65.14, 65.5]
M₋₆′ ∩ M₀
subalgebra M₋₆′ ∩ M₋₂
M₀′ ∩ M₆
subalgebra M₂′ ∩ M₆
α₃,₁
g₁ᵇˡᵏ ∈ M₀ → Q₀ = d e₂ e₁ e₃ e₂ ∈ M₄.
Q₀ implements M₀ ⊂ M₂; blocked parameter Λ = d⁻².
C₁ᵇˡᵏ = (M₂′ ∩ 𝒯)′ ∩ 𝒯 = M₂ by stage collapse.
M₀ ⊂ C₀ ⊂ M₂, and dense J(M₋₂ₘ′ ∩ M₀)J forces C₀ = M₀.
Use only the normal finite M₂ representation on L²(M₀).
4. Coherence really is extra — an exact finite check
T(x) = xᵀ and S(x) = VxᵀV* both preserve trace, G and q.
T(E₀₀) = E₀₀, S(E₀₀) = E₁₁: alternating maps have no limit.
E_G(q) = ½1. This is a finite example, not a generating II₁ tunnel.
Original proof and example locators: 65.1–65.14; complete argument retained beside this figure.
Human source: Popa, Classification of amenable subfactors, §4.5.1, printed223–224.
